commit.message:
* renaming
* add _scavenge_alot as gc cause preventing policy-upgrades

8397891

Hi all,

  please review this fix that upgrades young collections to full collections similar to before the JDK-8331557 changes.

Similar because of the four conditions, one was dropped. The four conditions were:
1) old gen capacity increased during young collection
2) free space in old generation is < 10000 bytes (it is not part of this change to fix this condition)
3) a whitebox induced young gc ignores 1+2
4) the allocation "should be allocated". Dropped because the condition was essentially doing nothing

The change also moves out two state variables that were only used during gc from `TenuredGeneration`; one was superfluous and already carried around (`_used_at_prologue`) and the other (`_capacity_at_prologue`) just inconvenient to use. Either way they should have never been part of `TenuredGeneration` imo.

Testing: gha, internal serial gc perf tests, reproducer

The change does not restore old behavior completely, i.e. due to inbetween changes how young and old gen are sized, different actual heap sizes will be achieved e.g. in that reproducer.

Thanks,
  Thomas
